name: TanShilongMario/PromptFill
headline: designed specifically for AI painting (GPT, Midjourney, Nano Banana, etc.). Help users quickly build, manage, and iterate complex prompts through a visual "fill-in-the-blank" interaction.  通过可视化的"填空"交互方式，帮助用户快速构建、管理和迭代复杂的 Prompt。
